description: Click an element by its ref from browser_snapshot, or else by the text it shows. Waits for any page load the click starts. Links and popups that open a new tab stay in the background, join this session, and are listed in the result. Clicking an option of a dropdown chooses it.

ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. e123.

tabId.description: Tab id from browser_open_tab or browser_list_tabs.

text.description: Instead of a ref: the visible text of the element to click, for something the snapshot gives no ref but you can see in a screenshot.

name: browser_click
